annotations.title: Save materials to the price book

description: Add or update materials in the trade's price book, so later quotes can use { code, qty } and the cost, unit and markup fill in. Materials used in quotes are also remembered automatically.

price_items.description: Materials the trade buys often, saved to their price book. Each: code (short id, optional), description, unit, unit_cost (pounds, what they pay), cost_includes_vat, markup_percent (optional, overrides the default).

trade_key.description: The trade's secret key from setup_trade (starts qbk_).

name: save_price_items
